name: Black River
blurb: Black River trips from the Pettibone Pass and Halls Creek accesses through Black River Falls and downstream toward the Mississippi. Above-dam trips finish at Holmgren; the dam separates them from downstream floats.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Markers identify agency-listed access; the map states whether a landing or an approximate facility area has been reviewed. Mileage is preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry; it is not a surveyed paddling route. Difficulty has not been independently rated for every section. Check current conditions, hazards and access with the managing agency before paddling.
sections.distanceReview: The preliminary 1.6-mile measurement follows a narrow source channel beside a longer visible river bend. Main-course mileage needs review; use this map to locate access areas, not to plan trip duration.
sections.routeReview: The USGS candidate follows a narrow eastern side channel. A main-course line has not been approved; no dotted route is shown.

sections.notes: Published guide mile markers support this 7.7-mile trip. Finish above Black River Falls Dam. Access markers distinguish the approximate facility areas from reviewed landings; the dotted line shows the river course and omits the final landing approach.
sections.routeReview: Holmgren is above Black River Falls Dam. Exact landing connections and the final dam-side approach are not mapped; the course overview stops about 200 metres before the access area.

notices.title: Finish above Black River Falls Dam
notices.text: Use Mark Holmgren Memorial Landing above the dam. Scout the signed takeout before launching and stay clear of the dam and exclusion barriers. Slower flowage water, wind and boat wakes can affect the trip. This map does not include a dam crossing.
notices.sourceName: Wisconsin DNR — Black River water recreation
